about: A rule of a kind of Pane, as tiling.toml says it, gives its new column a width where the command names none, and says where a Pane of it opens when no one named a place: right of the Pane in front, under it, into its Group, or last on its Project's workspace, over what the kind says of itself. It gives way with no Pane in front, and in the row from a workspace another Project owns; a place named and what is opened for an Agent go as without it. A list's new column, where no rule of its kind says a width, takes the narrowest of the Tiling's widths, for an Agent too; under another Pane it takes none.
